flags: The wiki's Extra Slots page was last changed Nov 2025, so slot rules are not confirmed against the Sept 2026 shop rebuild — check in-game.
Category investment bonus values are deliberately not shown: they could not be verified for the current patch.

categories.name: Weapon
categories.what: Gun damage, fire rate, ammo, headshots, bullet lifesteal. Buy these on heroes whose damage comes from shooting.
categories.bonus: Every Weapon item you buy also gives bonus Weapon Damage.

categories.name: Vitality
categories.what: Health, regeneration, bullet and spirit resist, stamina, sustain and escapes. Every hero buys some.
categories.bonus: Every Vitality item you buy also gives bonus Health.

categories.name: Spirit
categories.what: Ability damage (Spirit Power), cooldown reduction, ability range, duration and charges. Buy these on heroes whose damage comes from abilities.
categories.bonus: Every Spirit item you buy also gives bonus Spirit Power.

rules.title: Four price tiers
rules.text: Every item costs 800, 1,600, 3,200 or 6,400 souls. All items in a tier cost the same.

rules.title: 9 + 3 slots
rules.text: You start with 9 item slots that can hold any item. Each enemy Walker you destroy unlocks one of 3 extra ("flex") slots.

rules.title: Max 4 active items
rules.text: Active items (marked ACTIVE) go on extra hotkeys. You can own at most 4 of them at once.

rules.title: Upgrades discount
rules.text: Some items build out of a cheaper component. Upgrading consumes the component and subtracts its price from the new item.

rules.title: Selling
rules.text: Selling refunds 50%. If you haven't left the shop area since buying, you get the full price back, so misclicks are free.

rules.title: Where to shop
rules.text: Your base shop, a side shop by each lane's first Guardian (it closes for good once that Guardian dies) and two secret shops in the underground tunnels that both teams can use.

principles: You don't have to go back to base: walk to the nearest shop (lane shops are close) whenever you have 800+ souls.
Early: spend souls as soon as you can on 800-cost items. Several cheap items beat saving for one expensive item.
Buy for your damage type: gun heroes buy Weapon, ability heroes buy Spirit, and everyone buys a few Vitality items.
Getting killed by guns? Buy bullet resist. Getting killed by abilities? Buy spirit resist.
Later: sell your 800-cost items to make room for 3,200/6,400 items once your slots are full.
Not sure what to buy? Open the hero in the Heroes tab: it shows what players actually buy on that hero, by game phase.
